title: Total Quality Management: Main Exam, 7 December 2021
department: Department of Information Technology / enterprise Computing
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: What is total quality management?
What is quality control?
Explain the objectives of quality control in a software development organization.
List any five goals of a customer focus in software development that may improve the quality of the products.
Explain how employees' participation in organizational activities can improve the quality of the final product.
Explain any two TQM workforce factors that are applicable to an organization.
What are some factors that a successful implementation of ISO standards in an organization may depend on?
Explain the product life cycle assurance procedures that are necessary within the TQC policy and programmes.
What are some of the obstacles that may hinder employees' involvement in organizational activities so as to achieve quality?
Explain the stages that product designers follow during new product design and development.
Explain any four benefits an organization can get by adopting TQM.
Explain any four attributes that make up customer experience.
Explain the key roles that Six Sigma identifies for its successful implementation in an organization.
Discuss the evolution of TQM.
Explain any two ways that an organization can put in place to improve the product design and quality.
Explain the following methods of quality control as used in organizations.
Computer-aided quality control (CAQC)
Manual inspection
List down the elements of TQM that can be applied to an organization so as to achieve high quality products.
Explain any two sources of variation that may exist in a production process leading to defects and lack of consistency.
Explain any five customer experience strategies that may be applied in an organization to improve the quality of the final product.
